answer: An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the zenith index resolves every citation against the cipher checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the sparrow audit keeps the resolved set. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 38 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
